about: Polestar's route fixes, read by every Forge build from this checkout (never built into forge): `deliberate` holds v1's deliberate orders, the player-report fixes every route cut keeps; `overrides` holds the maintainer's hard rules (include, skip, revert, pairs) and the second-visit accepts left out on purpose (leftout). Each entry says why (`why`, or `reason` and `issue`). Check an edit with `forge data check-corrections`; docs/forge/routes.md sections 5 and 11 describe every key. $POLESTAR_ROUTE_FIXES names another file.

deliberate.about: v1's deliberate orders (player-report fixes pinned by tests/guides-reported.test.js and the guides' 'Order changes against the export' headers) as hard precedence pairs: every step of `a` comes before every step of `b` when both are in the order. Kinds: accept, task (an objective site of the quest), turnin. `group`: {q, size, why}: the group an elite or group quest wants (1 soloable elite, 2-4 a group of that many, 5 never taken) where Forever's creature data reads it wrong; the route may take it with a solo fallback (docs/forge/routes.md, Group quests).

overrides.about: Route overrides: one line each, honoured by every cut as hard constraints, shown as `override` in the skip and edit ledgers. include: {q, after: [accept|task|turnin, quest] (optional), reason, issue}: the quest is in the route (after that step when given). skip: {q, reason, issue}: never in the route. revert: {s: [accept|task|turnin, quest, task index (optional)], reason, issue} keeps that step between v1's neighbours (undoes a move); {q, edit: "drop"} keeps a quest the cut dropped; {q, edit: "insert"} undoes an insert (as skip). pairs: {a, b: [accept|task|turnin, quest], why, source}: a before b. leftout: {q, guide, reason, issue}: an accept of that guide whose prerequisite only an earlier visit to the zone brings, left out for characters without it instead of brought back (read by forge guide lint, not the route build). Lines whose reason or source starts F<n> come from player reports (forge judge feedback, data/local/research/RouteFeedback.json).

Its six Gooey Spider Legs drop from Duskwood's spiders without the quest (31-34% from Pygmy Venom Web Spiders, Venom Web Spiders, Green Recluses and Carrion Recluses, quest not required), so players carry some from Eight-Legged Menaces and the venom vials: in players' recordings 16 people took it, 13 handed it in, 6 of them at once with all six legs already in their bags.
